result.title: Cheers to the UK’s AI builders. 🇬🇧
result.description:
Tonight in London, our CEO Jensen Huang celebrated the people behind the UK’s AI ecosystem and announced new investments in Boltz, Foresight, Hiverge, Prima Mente, and Riverlane.

Boltz, a London-based AI startup founded by MIT researchers, builds biomolecular models and AI agents that help scientists predict molecular structures and interactions, and design potential new medicines.

Foresight, a London-based startup, helps owners of major infrastructure projects, including hyperscale data centers, predict completion dates, mitigate risks and accelerate time to revenue.

Hiverge, a Cambridge-based AI startup founded by researchers from Google DeepMind and the University of Cambridge, builds an AI discovery engine that automatically writes and optimizes algorithms for tasks such as faster AI training and complex logistics planning.

Prima Mente, a London-based AI biology startup, focuses on building biological foundation models to decode complex diseases and identify novel therapeutic targets, starting with Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s and ALS.

Riverlane, a Cambridge-based quantum computing startup, builds real-time error correction hardware and software that work across all major qubit types, helping quantum computers become reliable enough for practical use.

From new medicines to quantum computing, there’s plenty to build.

result.title: How NVIDIA AI Is Transforming Chip Design and Manufacturing
result.description:
Demand for advanced chips is accelerating, bringing greater complexity to semiconductor design and manufacturing. See how NVIDIA accelerated computing and AI are helping the industry build the AI-defined fab.

Explore how NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries, AI physics models, digital twins, AI agents, and robotics work together to accelerate simulation, optimize the fab, and support engineers and operators. See how NVIDIA Cosmos supports wafer defect classification and how production insights feed back into models to create a continuous cycle of learning and improvement.

From chip design to quality inspection, discover how AI connects people, equipment, and processes across semiconductor manufacturing.
